question: Which of the following was the last invasion by Mahmud Ghazni outside Punjab?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Somnath**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Somnath **was the **last invasion by Mahmud Ghazni **outside Punjab.
 
• The Turkish invader Mahmud Ghazni, attacked and raided the temple of Somnath in 1025 AD.
 
• **Mahmud of Ghazni:**
 
 
• He, also known as **Sultan Mahmud**, ruled the Ghaznavid Empire</s
